verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents a first-party hosted MCP server at https://api.cfo.ai/mcp with a dedicated setup guide (`claude mcp add --transport http`), plus Claude desktop/claude.ai connector instructions. It uses OAuth sign-in as the user and has documented agent tools, including model read/write and the edit_chats/inspect_chats handoff to Ari. A probe confirmed the MCP documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server connects and works as documented.
